nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used for the two-step ownership transfer pattern.
Total token supply of the DU30 token, set in the constructor.
Mapping of token holder addresses to their token balances.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance amount.
ERC20 transfer: debits msg.sender balances via safeSub and credits recipient via safeAdd.
ERC20 approve: records allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
ERC20 transferFrom: debits from-balance and allowance and credits the recipient.
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on an arbitrary spender contract address.
onlyOwner function assigning the pending newOwner address.
Accepts ownership when msg.sender equals newOwner and moves owner into newOwner.
onlyOwner sweep of arbitrary ERC20 tokens held by the contract via an external call.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject plain ETH transfers.
SafeMath subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath addition guarded by require(c >= a) overflow check.
Externally controlled caller address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) made inside approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) made inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Unsigned subtraction of token balances/allowances in transfer and transferFrom susceptible to underflow.
_newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
spender parameter of approve/approveAndCall used as external call target.
tokens amount parameter supplied by the caller.
to recipient parameter of transfer.
from account parameter of transferFrom.
Local return variable c inside safeSub holding the subtraction result.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the debited token owner inside transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is recorded as approver and forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard on transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the attacker-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates the debit computation to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit computation to safeAdd.
transfer performs an unchecked-by-inline-arithmetic balance subtraction.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom delegates subtraction to safeSub.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance subtractions.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall performs an external call to receiveApproval on a caller-controlled address.
The spender contract invoked by receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall before state settles.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
The arbitrary ERC20 contract can call back into transferAnyERC20Token.
Stored balances feed the unsigned subtraction that may underflow.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the privileged newOwner state variable.
spender parameter determines the external contract target of approveAndCall.
tokens parameter determines the transferred amount in transfer.
to parameter determines the credited account in transfer.
from parameter determines the debited account in transferFrom.
Local variable c holds the safeSub result and is returned to the callers.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is a parameter of transferOwnership and directly feeds the newOwner state variable.
spender is a parameter of approveAndCall and directly determines the external callback target.
tokens is a parameter of transfer and directly controls the balance movement.
to is a parameter of transfer and directly controls the credited balance entry.
from is a parameter of transferFrom and directly controls the debited balance entry.
Local variable c is only used inside safeSub and should be folded into the safeSub function node.
